messages.subject: Fwd: Data Mining Survey
parts:
Hi Everyone,

If your interested in Data Mining, then you might like to take part
in this software survey. It takes a little time to fill it out,
however, you can request a report on their findings. It mentions a
whole gambit of tools, there is even a R option in one of the boxes.
I for one would be interested in the intelligence provided in this
survey, to see just what the industry in general is using, plus I
would like to see the figures on R users, to see how much opensource
R tools like Rattle have entered the general marketplace.

Regards
Tony


http://www.rexeranalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-2010-Intro2.html

Thanks Tony for encouraging respondents to this survey. Others may be
interested in this comment from Bob Muenchen (author of the R for SAS
and SPSS users book) - if you use R for data mining, why not respond -
unfortunately such survey's don't really mean too much, except perhaps
which vendor was most effective in encouraging respondents.... all the
same - would be interesting if there was a strong R response.
